title: Muslin in small lots
body: Jalal of Sonargaon opens a bale of Bengal muslin. The palace steward asks for the finest pieces for gifts. The cloth sellers waiting behind him cannot buy a bale between them today. Jalal offers to sell the state a few pieces at the going price or let the sellers pool their coin and make a bid.

choices.label: Buy the finest pieces for the court
choices.outcome_text: The steward has cloth fit for gifts. Jalal is paid on the spot, but the sellers say the pieces their customers wanted never reached the market.

choices.label: Let the cloth sellers bid together
choices.outcome_text: The sellers pool their coin, agree a price with Jalal, and divide the muslin. They can sell by the piece, but the palace steward leaves without his gifts.
